description: This Java class is a Spring configuration component that initializes sample data for development or local profiling environments by inserting sample notes into the repository on application startup.

classes.name: DevDataLoader
classes.description: A configuration class that loads sample notes data during application startup for development profiles.

methods.name: seedNotes
methods.description: Defines a CommandLineRunner bean that seeds sample notes into the repository if it's empty during startup, specifically for 'dev' and 'local' profiles.
